name: Kurumi-chan Ninja
original_name: くるみちゃんにんじゃあ
source:
A legendary black ship arrives at Minato shore shipping suspicious black chests. A ninja girl is sent to investigate the contents of the chests.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-july-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
传说中的黑船抵达港口海岸，运来一只只可疑的黑色箱子。一名忍者少女奉命调查箱中究竟装着什么。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-july-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
